verdict.rationale: PayPal ships both merchant-facing (MCP server, agent toolkit) and consumer-facing (ACP/UCP conversational checkout via ChatGPT/Google AI Mode) natural-language operation paths, with runtime probes confirming the MCP server is live and the agent-toolkit package is published and current. Docs explicitly describe agents completing purchases and managing orders/refunds/disputes 'through conversational interfaces' and 'natural language.' Missing for 10: independent third-party hands-on testing of actual natural-language interactions and concrete end-to-end conversational transaction examples beyond first-party docs.
